#### What this PR does / why we need it:
- Add new version fields to version.Info struct:

- Improve version information documentation and OpenAPI generation
- Modify version routes and documentation to reflect new version information structure

issue_context.title: [Compatibility Version] Extend /Version Endpoint for compatibility versions
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?


This issue tracks the implementation of the `/version` endpoint enhancements outlined in [KEP-4330](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/e49b717dcf72e2484ffead763a0cd06bbf7a5f5d/keps/sig-architecture/4330-compatibility-version). The goal is to augment the `/version` endpoint to include more related fields when the Compatibility Versions feature is enabled. 

Updated version info fields:
```golang
    // emulated version major
    Major        string `json:"major"`
    // emulated version minor
    Minor        string `json:"minor"`
+  // binary version major
+   EmulationMajor string `json:"binaryMajor"`
+  // binary version minor
+   EmulationMinor string `json:"binaryMinor"`
+  // min compatibility version
+   MinCompatibilityVersionMajor string `json:"minCompatibilityMajor"`
+  // min compatibility version
+   MinCompatibilityVersionMinor string `json:"minCompatibilityMinor"`
...
...
```

These fields should accurately reflect the binary version, the --emulation-version flag value, and the --min-compatibility-version flag value.  

### Why is this needed?

Ref: [KEP-4330#version-introspection](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/e49b717dcf72e2484ffead763a0cd06bbf7a5f5d/keps/sig-architecture/4330-compatibility-versions#version-introspection)

review_comments: I did. It does look cleaner in this type, but requires a much larger scope of refactoring, including update the client side. We sure can follow up to do so but I don't think it worth the effort.

Why is this change needed?  I don't know enough about openapi offhand to know if this is semantically important, but it smells semantically important.  I wouldn't expect it to change unless we must change it.

~It doesn't need to change technically but now the response is not just the "built" or "code" version, would it makes more send to update it?~
I've updated to leave the "operationid" unchaged.

```suggestion
Info returns the version information of a component.
// Deprecated: Use Info() from effective version instead.
```

Given that `apimachineryversion.Info` contains binaryVersion, emulationVersion, and minCompatbiilityVersion, the functions and variables for `BinaryVersion`, `EmulationVersion`, `MinCompatibilityVersion`, `binaryVersion`, `emulationVersion`, `minCompatibilityVersion` are all footguns that can be conflicting because `version.Version` now includes all that information via its `.info`.  The interfaces need to be cleaned up here as part of the switch or perhaps `pkg/util/version/version.go` should be focused on a single version.  I'm flexible for a solution, but the potential for conflict needs to be eliminated.

good point. @yongruilin can we remove `apimachineryversion.Info` from
```
type Version struct {
	components    []uint
	semver        bool
	preRelease    string
	buildMetadata string
	info          apimachineryversion.Info
}
```
so that pkg/util/version/version.go is focused on a single version?
Detached the info field from util/version. PTAL
